acceptanceCriteria: A spec (or a section of an existing affected spec) owns the Python adapter with numbered requirements, non-goals, failure modes and an experimental qualification label.
Existing tests are traced to those requirements; untested requirements are listed as gaps.
body: Found by the 2026-10-20 read-only Beamfall setup review (corvint 1.0.0-rc.3 build 676; evidence under the session scratchpad beamfall-review/). internal/liveverify/affected/python/python.go runs in every affected call, yet nothing under docs/specs cites affected/python, so its claims are unqualified. Beamfall core-history (106 .py) and oscillux depend on it.

title: affected/python is registered in languages.All() but has no owning spec, requirements or qualification state
